| `conflicts` | list of string | — | Packages this PKGBUILD conflicts with. |
| `contributors` | list of string | — | Contributors listed in PKGBUILD comments. |
| `depends` | list of string | — | Runtime dependencies required by this package. |
| `description` | string | — | Short description of the package for PKGBUILD. |
| `directory` | string | — | Subdirectory in the git repo for committed files. |
| `git_ssh_command` | string | — | Custom SSH command for git operations. Takes precedence over `private_key` when both are set. |
| `git_url` | string | — | AUR SSH git URL override. Defaults to `ssh://aur@aur.archlinux.org/<package>.git`, derived from the resolved package name; set this only for a non-standard endpoint. |
| `homepage` | string | — | Project homepage URL. |
| `ids` | list of string | — | Build IDs filter: only include artifacts whose `id` is in this list. |
| `if` | string | — | Template-conditional gate: when the rendered result is falsy (`"false"` / `"0"` / `"no"` / empty), the AUR publisher is skipped. Render failure hard-errors. The `aurs[].if:` conditional gate. An absent, empty or blank `if:` imposes no gate and always runs; the falsy test applies to what a non-blank gate renders. |
| `install` | string | — | Content for a .install file (post-install/pre-remove scripts). |
| `license` | string | — | SPDX license identifier (e.g., "MIT", "Apache-2.0"). |
| `maintainers` | list of string | — | PKGBUILD maintainer entries (e.g., "Name <email@example.com>"). |
| `name` | string | — | Override the package name (default: crate name + "-bin"). |
| `optdepends` | list of string | — | Optional dependencies with descriptions (e.g., "fzf: fuzzy finder support"). |
| `package` | string | — | Custom PKGBUILD `package()` function body. |
| `private_key` | string | — | The SSH private key itself, as its PEM or OpenSSH text. Supports templates, so a key is usually read from the environment: `private_key: "{{ .Env.AUR_SSH_KEY }}"`. Written to a temporary file with mode 0600 for the push. |
| `provides` | list of string | — | Packages this PKGBUILD provides (virtual package names). |
| `rel` | string | — | Package release number (default: "1"). |
| `replaces` | list of string | — | Packages this PKGBUILD replaces (for upgrade paths from old package names). |
| `required` | bool | — | Override whether this publisher failing should fail the overall release.<br><br>Default: `false` — a failure here is logged but does not abort the release. Set to `true` to fail the release on any error. |
| `retain_on_rollback` | bool | — | When `true`, a triggered rollback leaves this publisher's work in place and does not try to undo it. Default `false`. |
| `skip` | 0 \| 1 \| bool \| string | — | Skip this AUR config. Accepts bool or template string (e.g. `"{{ if .IsSnapshot }}true{{ endif }}"` for conditional skip). Accepts the legacy `disable:` spelling via serde alias for back-compat. |
| `skip_upload` | 0 \| 1 \| bool \| string | — | Skip publishing. `"true"` always skips; `"auto"` skips for prereleases. Accepts bool or template string. |
| `url_template` | string | — | Custom URL template for download URLs (overrides release URL). |

## `crates[].publish.aur_source` {#crates-publish-aur-source}

Constrained to a typed enum because AUR source pkgs build from the upstream tarball (no binary artifacts to filter), so the value's only role is as the `Amd64` template var consumed by `prepare:` / `build:` / `package:` script bodies — typos must fail at parse time and never silently render an invalid string into the PKGBUILD. When unset, defaults to `v1` at template-render time. |

| `commit_msg_template` | string | — | Custom commit message template. |

| `homepage` | string | — | Project homepage URL. |
| `ids` | list of string | — | Has no effect on a source package: the PKGBUILD builds from the one source archive the release carries and reads no build artifacts. |
| `if` | string | — | Template-conditional gate: when the rendered result is falsy (`"false"` / `"0"` / `"no"` / empty), the AUR source config is skipped. Render failure hard-errors. The `aur_sources[].if:`. An absent, empty or blank `if:` imposes no gate and always runs; the falsy test applies to what a non-blank gate renders. |

| `makedepends` | list of string | — | Build-time dependencies (source packages need these). |
| `name` | string | — | Override the package name (default: crate name, no -bin suffix). |

| `package` | string | — | Custom `package()` function body for PKGBUILD. |
| `prepare` | string | — | Custom `prepare()` function body for PKGBUILD. |

| `retain_on_rollback` | bool | — | When `true`, a triggered rollback leaves this publisher's work in place and does not try to undo it. Default `false`. |

## `crates[].publish.krew` {#crates-publish-krew}
| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|-------|------|---------|-------------|
| `amd64_variant` | "v1" \| "v2" \| "v3" \| "v4" | — | amd64 microarchitecture variant filter (`v1` / `v2` / `v3` / `v4`). Only artifacts matching this variant are included. Default: `v1`. Typed as `Amd64Variant`, so any value outside `v1`..`v4` is rejected when the config is parsed. |
| `arm_variant` | string | — | ARM version filter (e.g. "6", "7"). Only artifacts matching this variant are included. Default: `6`. |
| `caveats` | string | — | Post-install message shown to the user. |
| `commit_author` | object | — | Commit author with optional signing. |
| `commit_msg_template` | string | — | Custom commit message template. |
| `description` | string | — | Full description of the kubectl plugin. |
| `homepage` | string | — | Project homepage URL for the plugin. |
| `ids` | list of string | — | Build IDs filter: only include artifacts whose `id` is in this list. |
| `if` | string | — | Template-conditional gate: when the rendered result is falsy (`"false"` / `"0"` / `"no"` / empty), the Krew publisher is skipped. Render failure hard-errors. Config key: `krews[].if:`. An absent, empty or blank `if:` imposes no gate and always runs; the falsy test applies to what a non-blank gate renders. |
| `mode` | "auto" \| "bot" \| "pr-direct" | — | Which krew-index submission path to take.<br><br>- `auto` (default): probe whether the plugin already exists in `kubernetes-sigs/krew-index`. Already present → `bot` (the hosted krew-release-bot opens the version-bump PR server-side); definitively absent → `pr-direct` (anodizer opens the initial fork PR). A probe that can't reach a definitive answer (rate-limit, network error) hard-errors and does not guess, so a transient blip never routes an existing plugin into a maintainer-hostile fork PR. - `bot`: always POST to the krew-release-bot webhook. Use when the plugin is known to be in krew-index and you want to skip the membership probe entirely. - `pr-direct`: always open a fork PR against krew-index. Use for the initial submission, or a self-hosted krew-index mirror the hosted bot can't reach. |
| `name` | string | — | Override the plugin name (default: crate name). |
| `repository` | object | — | Unified repository config with branch, token, PR, git SSH support. (Replaces the legacy `manifests_repo:` / `upstream_repo:` form.) The upstream PR target is derived from `repository.pull_request.base` when set, falling back to the canonical kubernetes-sigs/krew-index. |
| `required` | bool | — | Override whether this publisher failing should fail the overall release.<br><br>Default: `false` — a failure here is logged but does not abort the release. Set to `true` to fail the release on any error. |
| `retain_on_rollback` | bool | — | When `true`, a triggered rollback leaves this publisher's work in place and does not try to undo it. Default `false`. |
| `short_description` | string | — | One-line summary of the kubectl plugin (max 255 chars). |
| `skip` | 0 \| 1 \| bool \| string | — | Skip this Krew config. Accepts bool or template string (e.g. `"{{ if .IsSnapshot }}true{{ endif }}"` for conditional skip). Distinct from `skip_upload` so users can opt out of generating the manifest entirely (common when a project is not a kubectl plugin and has no krew channel). |
| `skip_upload` | 0 \| 1 \| bool \| string | — | Skip publishing. `"true"` always skips; `"auto"` skips for prereleases. Accepts bool or template string. |
| `update_existing_pr` | 0 \| 1 \| bool \| string | — | When true, force-push the updated plugin manifest to the existing PR branch when a PR for the same head branch already exists. The PR content is updated in place, so no duplicate is created. When false (default), the push is skipped and a warning is emitted so the operator sees that the publisher did not update the PR. |
| `url_template` | string | — | Custom URL template for download URLs (overrides release URL). |

## `crates[].publish.nix` {#crates-publish-nix}
| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|-------|------|---------|-------------|
| `amd64_variant` | "v1" \| "v2" \| "v3" \| "v4" | — | amd64 microarchitecture variant filter (`v1` / `v2` / `v3` / `v4`). Only artifacts matching this variant are included. Default: `v1`. Typed as `Amd64Variant`, so any value outside `v1`..`v4` is rejected when the config is parsed. |
| `changelog` | string | — | URL for `meta.changelog`. When unset, anodizer derives `<host>/<owner>/<repo>/releases/tag/<tag>` from the crate's `release` repository and the release tag (matching what ripgrep/fd set in nixpkgs). Set this to override (e.g. a `…/blob/<tag>/CHANGELOG.md` URL). Templated. Omitted only when no release repo is configured and no explicit value is given. |
| `commit_author` | object | — | Commit author with optional signing. |
| `commit_msg_template` | string | — | Custom commit message template. |
| `dependencies` | list of object | — | Nix package dependencies with optional OS filtering. |
| `description` | string | — | Short description of the Nix derivation. |
| `extra_install` | string | — | Additional install commands appended after the main install. |
| `formatter` | string | — | Nix formatter to run on the generated file: "alejandra" or "nixfmt". |
| `homepage` | string | — | Project homepage URL. |
| `ids` | list of string | — | Build IDs filter: only include artifacts whose `id` is in this list. |
| `if` | string | — | Template-conditional gate: when the rendered result is falsy (`"false"` / `"0"` / `"no"` / empty), the Nix publisher is skipped. Render failure hard-errors. Config key: `nix[].if:`. An absent, empty or blank `if:` imposes no gate and always runs; the falsy test applies to what a non-blank gate renders. |
| `install` | string | — | Custom install commands (replaces auto-generated binary install). |
| `license` | string | — | License for the derivation's `meta.license`. Accepts a nix `lib.licenses` attribute (e.g. `mit`, `asl20`) or an SPDX expression (e.g. `MIT`, `Apache-2.0`, `MIT OR Apache-2.0`). A known single id maps to `lib.licenses.<attr>`; an `OR`/`AND` list of known ids maps to `with lib.licenses; [ … ]`. An unknown id or an unparseable compound (e.g. a `WITH` exception) degrades to a quoted-string `license` in `meta`; it is not rejected and never yields an invalid attr-path. When unset, the license is derived from the crate's `Cargo.toml [package].license`. |
| `long_description` | string | — | Long-form description for `meta.longDescription`, rendered as a multi-line `longDescription = '' … '';` block. Optional; omitted when unset. Templated. |
| `main_program` | string | — | Value for `meta.mainProgram` in the generated Nix derivation. When set, the rendered derivation includes `mainProgram = "<value>";` inside the `meta` block, telling Nix which binary `nix run` should execute when the derivation contains multiple executables. Templated: supports `{{ Version }}` etc. Omitted when unset. |
| `maintainers` | list of string | — | nixpkgs maintainer handles (from `lib.maintainers`) rendered as `maintainers = with lib.maintainers; [ alice bob ];` in the derivation's `meta`. These are nixpkgs *handles* (e.g. `globin`, `zowoq`), NOT `Name <email>` author strings — a nixpkgs review rejects a derivation whose `meta.maintainers` is absent. When unset the derivation still emits `maintainers = [ ];` (an empty-but-present list is valid and clears the "field absent" rejection); a user fills in their handle. Each entry is rendered verbatim as a Nix identifier, so values must be valid `lib.maintainers` attribute names. |
| `name` | string | — | Override the derivation name (default: crate name). |
| `path` | string | — | Path for the .nix file in the repository (default: `pkgs/<name>/default.nix`). |
| `post_install` | string | — | Post-install commands (postInstall phase). |
| `repository` | object | — | Unified repository config with branch, token, PR, git SSH support. |
| `required` | bool | — | Override whether this publisher failing should fail the overall release.<br><br>Default: `false` — a failure here is logged but does not abort the release. Set to `true` to fail the release on any error. |
| `retain_on_rollback` | bool | — | When `true`, a triggered rollback leaves this publisher's work in place and does not try to undo it. Default `false`. |
| `skip` | 0 \| 1 \| bool \| string | — | Skip this Nix config. Accepts bool or template string (e.g. `"{{ if .IsSnapshot }}true{{ endif }}"` for conditional skip). Distinct from `skip_upload` so users can model both intents — disable means "don't generate at all", skip_upload means "generate but don't push". Without this field, `nix: { skip: true }` was silently dropped by the serde unknown-field default. |
| `skip_upload` | 0 \| 1 \| bool \| string | — | Skip publishing. `"true"` always skips; `"auto"` skips for prereleases. Accepts bool or template string. |
| `url_template` | string | — | Custom URL template for download URLs (overrides release URL). |

## `release.preflight` {#release-preflight}
The `release.preflight:` block.
| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|-------|------|---------|-------------|
| `fail_on_error` | 0 \| 1 \| bool \| string | `true` | Stop the run when a release preflight check fails. Default: `true`.<br><br>The checks, per forge:<br><br>- GitHub: the token can push to the release repository, and when a release already exists at the tag it is not immutable. An immutable release cannot be updated and its assets cannot be replaced, so the release would fail. - GitLab: the token has Developer access or higher on the project. A run authenticating with a CI job token skips this check, since a job token cannot read the project. - Gitea: the token can push to the repository. - A missing token is a failed check on every forge.<br><br>With `false`, a failed check is reported as a warning that ends in `continuing because release.preflight.fail_on_error is false`, and the run continues; the release then fails at creation if the problem is real. The token is also an environment requirement of the release (`ANODIZER_GITHUB_TOKEN`, `GITHUB_TOKEN` or `GH_TOKEN`; `GITLAB_TOKEN`; `GITEA_TOKEN`; or `--token`), so a missing token still stops the run at the environment check whatever this field says, and with `false` the release preflight's own report of it is a warning beside that failure. A check that `preflight.strict` turns into a failure is a failed check here too.<br><br>A crate's own value wins over the top-level `release:` block's; an empty value counts as unset. Accepts a bool, an unquoted `1` or `0`, or a template that renders to `true`, `false`, `1` or `0` (any letter case). Any other render, an empty one included, stops the run with an error naming the value.<br><br><code>release:</code><br><code>  preflight:</code><br><code>    fail_on_error: "{{ not IsNightly }}"   # warn only on nightly runs</code> |

## `notarize.macos` {#notarize-macos}
Cross-platform macOS signing and notarization via `rcodesign`.
| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|-------|------|---------|-------------|
| `enabled` | 0 \| 1 \| bool \| string | — | Older spelling of `skip:`, inverted: `enabled: true` is `skip: false` and `enabled: false` is `skip: true`. A template skips the entry when it renders empty, `false`, `0` or `no`. When both `enabled` and `skip` are absent, the entry runs. |
| `ids` | list of string | — | Build IDs whose darwin binaries and universal binaries this entry signs. Default: the project name; with no project name, every darwin binary. |
| `notarize` | [object](#notarize-macos-notarize) | — | Notarization configuration (App Store Connect API key). Omit for sign-only. |
| `sign` | object | — | Signing configuration (P12 certificate). |
| `skip` | 0 \| 1 \| bool \| string | — | Skip this entry. Accepts a bool or a template string; a template skips when it renders `true` or `1`. When absent, the entry runs.<br><br>The older `enabled:` key is still accepted and inverted: `enabled: true` becomes `skip: false`, `enabled: false` becomes `skip: true`. |

## `notarize.macos[].notarize` {#notarize-macos-notarize}
App Store Connect API key configuration for `rcodesign notary-submit`.
| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|-------|------|---------|-------------|
| `issuer_id` | string | — | App Store Connect API key issuer UUID. Templates allowed. |
| `key` | string | — | Path to .p8 key file or base64-encoded contents. Templates allowed. |
| `key_id` | string | — | API key ID. Templates allowed. |
| `timeout` | string | — | Timeout for notarization status polling. Humantime-style string (e.g. `"10m"`, `"15s"`). Default when omitted: `"10m"`, maximum `"20m"`. The App Store Connect token lifetime is derived from this value and Apple rejects a token that lives longer, so a larger timeout fails config validation.<br><br>A duration: one or more whole numbers, each followed by a unit (ms, s, m, h or d), such as 90s, 1h30m or 2d. Spaces and tabs may separate the parts. The total may be at most one year (31536000s); a longer value is refused when the config loads. |
| `wait` | bool | — | Whether to wait for notarization to complete. Default: `false`; `timeout` applies only while waiting. |

## `notarize.macos_native` {#notarize-macos-native}
Native macOS signing and notarization via `codesign` + `xcrun notarytool`.
| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|-------|------|---------|-------------|
| `enabled` | 0 \| 1 \| bool \| string | — | Older spelling of `skip:`, inverted: `enabled: true` is `skip: false` and `enabled: false` is `skip: true`. A template skips the entry when it renders empty, `false`, `0` or `no`. When both `enabled` and `skip` are absent, the entry runs. |
| `ids` | list of string | — | Build IDs whose darwin artifacts this entry signs and notarizes: app bundles and DMGs with `use: dmg`, PKGs with `use: pkg`. Default: the project name; with no project name, every matching artifact. |
| `notarize` | [object](#notarize-macos-native-notarize) | — | Native notarization configuration (xcrun notarytool). |
| `sign` | object | — | Native signing configuration (Keychain). |
| `skip` | 0 \| 1 \| bool \| string | — | Skip this entry. Accepts a bool or a template string; a template skips when it renders `true` or `1`. When absent, the entry runs.<br><br>The older `enabled:` key is still accepted and inverted: `enabled: true` becomes `skip: false`, `enabled: false` becomes `skip: true`. |
| `use` | "dmg" \| "pkg" | — | Artifact type to sign and notarize: `dmg` (default) or `pkg`. Any other value (`zip`, `app`, …) fails when the config loads. |

## `notarize.macos_native[].notarize` {#notarize-macos-native-notarize}
Native notarization configuration for `xcrun notarytool`.
| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|-------|------|---------|-------------|
| `profile_name` | string | — | Notarytool stored credentials profile name. Templates allowed. |
| `timeout` | string | — | Timeout for `xcrun notarytool submit --timeout`. Humantime-style string (e.g. `"10m"`, `"15s"`, `"1h"`). Default: `"10m"`.<br><br>A duration: one or more whole numbers, each followed by a unit (ms, s, m, h or d), such as 90s, 1h30m or 2d. Spaces and tabs may separate the parts. The total may be at most one year (31536000s); a longer value is refused when the config loads. |
| `wait` | bool | — | Whether to wait for notarization to complete and staple the ticket. Default: `false`. |
